svg.text: Three ways this runs, and the infrastructure deliberately left unapplied
One Cloud Run service, not two. A split web tier has to mint an identity token for every call to a private API service, which nginx cannot do natively; one origin removes that.
Lifespan attempts an Odoo sync, guarded
prefix stripped — without it every screen 404s
pytest → vitest → a fresh API on :8099 →
pytest.ini already sets it; passing it again
it read as a failure once
A frozen production build. The round-1 judge
tested a dev server that hot-reloaded mid-verdict
move to another port between testers
A manual uvicorn start does not do it —
Why none of it is running
• Nothing in infra/terraform is applied. It stands for the
MVP's shape, not this prototype's, and the deploy script
says so in its own header rather than in a wiki.
• Credentials come from backend/.env, gitignored: the names
